GBUK Group|caretip™ secure.description: Continence Care CareTip™ Secure The CareTip Secure fixation device is designed to provide secure fixation of uretheral catheters. Appropriate securement may reduce adverse outcomes, including catheter dislodgement, tissue trauma and necrosis, inflammation and urinary tract infections (UTIs). Features a medical silicone gel adhesive, renowned for exceptional skin compatibility Designed for pain free and residue free removal – Minimising discomfort and trauma to fragile skin Durable 360 degree swivel clip to allow comfortable patient movement without tugging, reducing the risk of urethral trauma or catheter dislodgement Easy to apply, with secure latch, effectively resists accidental pull forces Translucent material,to allow skin inspection beneath Suitable for continuous use for up to 7 days Shower-proof

GBUK Group|caretip™ catheter.description: Continence Care CareTip™ Catheter The CareTip™ intermittent catheter is designed to minimise urethral trauma. The superior patent protected hydrophilic coating technology* can reduce coefficient of friction to <0.02** or below (Excellent/Low based on industry standards) Male and Female variants available Quick and easy to use straight form the packaging The ready to use hydrophilic coating maintains stable super-lubricity, ensuring a comfortable experience for patients Rounded and smooth eyelet holes provide less resistance and a more comfortable insertion and withdrawal Adhesive sticker and hanging hole to assist with ease of catheterisation wherever you may be The touch-free gripper is hygienic and protects against urinary tract infections *Independently researched and developed patent protected coating technology
